title: Agent output (identical for Configuration A and B)
description: Both configurations must emit exactly this shape so the grader compares like with like. Configuration B's extra criterion tracking lives in its trace, not in a different output schema.

configuration.description: A0 = plain Claude, no tools, one shot. A = same scaffold with the two case tools. B = our workflow (A + enforced criteria ledger). C = external comparator (e.g. Biomni) via adapter.

model.description: Exact model id. A and B MUST match; if C differs, the efficiency comparison is reported as 'different stack', not head-to-head.

input_tokens.description: Sum over every LLM call in the run, from the provider's usage field. Includes cached-read tokens (see cache_read_tokens).

tool_calls.description: Must equal len(actions_taken) for A and B.

network_calls.description: Live HTTP calls made outside the stub (should be 0 for A/B in eval mode; for C, count and report — a nonzero value means C could see pubmed/opentargets that eval mode hides from A/B).

run.description: Replicate index (seed). Report pass rate across replicates, not a single pass/fail.

source.description: Either a pipeline source key (mygene | ensembl_orthology.<species> | impc | gtex | opentargets | pubmed) or a context_datasets[].id from the manifest.

locator.description: Field path, tissue name, sample id, or record id that lets the grader find the exact datum.

caveats.description: Free text. Grader scans these (and rationale) for the must_detect strings in the reference answer.

actions_taken.description: Every tool call, in order. Used for the completion row and for case-3 retrieval grading.
